term_type.description: Terminal type to advertise to the login session (e.g., 'linux', 'vt100').

login_shell.description: Login shell to invoke (full path). systemd's default is '/bin/sh'.

getty_options.description: Command-line options passed to agetty. Common flags: '-8' (8-bit clean), '-o' (omit login name prompt), '-p' (pre-pend login name), '--keep-baud' (serial only).

baud_rate.description: Default serial baud rate for non-console terminals (ignored for console).

fast_boot.description: If true, skip the START_DELAY to speed up boot (useful for development or fast hardware).

start_delay.description: Seconds to wait before starting getty on serial ports (helpful for slow devices or USB-serial adapters).

extra_tty_names.description: List of extra TTY device names (e.g., 'tty4') where you want agetty to start (beyond the default tty1–tty6).

items.description: TTY name without path, e.g., 'tty4' or 'ttyS0'.

locale.description: Locale encoding and language (e.g., 'en_US.UTF-8', 'C.UTF-8'). Used for character encoding in login prompts.
